figurative_meaning_bn: বাবুগিরি করা; দায়িত্বজ্ঞানহীন হয়ে আলস্যে দিন কাটানো
figurative_meaning_en: Acting like a babu (pompous clerk); passing days in laziness without a sense of responsibility
similar_in_english: putting on airs while being idle
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চাকরি না করে কোঁচা দুলিয়ে বেড়ানো করে।
এই বয়সে কোঁচা দুলিয়ে বেড়ানো উচিত নয়, কাজে মন দাও।
example_sentences_in_english: He doesn't work; he just swings his hem and wanders around.
At this age, you shouldn't just lounge about swinging your hem; focus on work.
history: Refers to the 'babu' culture from British colonial era, where clerks (babus) were seen as idle and showy.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of leisurely strolling with dangling garment edges, symbolizing carefree idleness.
